ablation_study: Input Resolution & Architectural Receptive Field Sensitivity

224x224.pneumothorax_pleural_line_detection_rate: 14.3% (Sub-millimeter apical line smoothed by bilinear interpolation)

448x448.atelectasis_linear_band_preservation: Discoid atelectatic bands cleanly distinguished from diaphragm

binary_cross_entropy.gradient_behavior: Dominated by vast majority negative class, suppressing minority condition gradients (Pneumothorax, Pneumonia).

focal_loss_gamma_2.gradient_behavior: Down-weights easy confident negatives, prioritizing hard boundary examples (acinar consolidation vs pulmonary edema).

class_balanced_loss.gradient_behavior: Accounts for effective volume of rare pathologies in feature space, preventing gradient starvation.

gradcam_localization_investigation.localization_finding: A 7x7 spatial CAM resolution represents an effective patch size of 32x32 pixels on the original image. For localized apical pneumothoraces or subsegmental basilar atelectasis spanning only 5-15 pixels, the 7x7 CAM lacks the spatial resolution to isolate the finding, producing diffuse or falsely off-center activations.
